newsitem.title: USA: CME Dec live cattle has late surge before expiring.
newsitem.headline: CME Dec live cattle has late surge before expiring.

text.p: CME December live cattle futures expired at midday after late short-covering by locals had taken prices sharply higher in the last few minutes of trading, floor sources said.

December touched a peak of 67.950 cents late and settled up 0.805 cents at 67.425 cents. Floor sources said conditions were fairly thin and the comparatively strong close meant it was possible there might be a few deliveries, which would be the first against the December contract.
The open interest on the spot month had fallen sharply on Friday to 1,371 contracts from 2,983 the previous day.
